clue.text: Row with each other, having to endure the same hardships?

definitions.meaning: rowers pulling together share a single vessel on the water

definitions.text: having to endure the same hardships
definitions.meaning: the idiom for people facing a shared predicament

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom describes people sharing one predicament, and literally describes crew rowing together in one vessel.

clue.text: Transported after bus initially is delayed

indicators.note: after puts the second piece after the bus letter
initially takes the opening letter of the word bus

parts.note: transported with joy means elated

explanation.surface: Delighted passengers on a bus that is running late.
explanation.definitionFit: Arriving late or overdue is a direct synonym for delayed.

clue.text: Picture belonging to matching series?

parts.note: belonging to a group means being in it
a set is a matching series of things

explanation.surface: A painting that is part of a matching collection.
explanation.definitionFit: A small picture placed within a larger one, such as a map detail, is this.

clue.text: Spectacles, initially free of charge, put in cases

indicators.note: put in says one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: court cases are trials

indicators.note: initially takes the opening letter of each of the three words

explanation.surface: Glasses given away at no cost, packed in their holders.
explanation.definitionFit: Glasses with three lens zones are a type of spectacles.

clue.text: Like part of breakfast Margaret's first rejected

indicators.note: the opening letter of the name is thrown out

parts.note: Peggy is a pet form of Margaret

explanation.surface: Margaret turned down the first course of the morning meal.
explanation.definitionFit: Tasting or covered with egg is like the eggs served at breakfast.

clue.text: Unusual sort of one act play

indicators.note: sort here works as a verb, to sort the letters into a new order

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A single-act drama is an odd kind of thing.
explanation.definitionFit: Not representative of the type is a direct synonym for unusual.

clue.text: Theatrical dame — gosh — heard in EastEnders

indicators.note: EastEnders is a London-set TV soap; Cockneys drop their aitches, so the word is said without its H

parts.note: heavens is an exclamation like gosh

explanation.surface: A stage actress exclaims in a soap opera.
explanation.walkthrough: Dame Edith Evans was a celebrated English stage actress; EastEnders is a BBC soap set in East London, whose Cockney speech drops the H.
explanation.definitionFit: Dame Edith Evans was a famous British stage actress honoured as a dame.

clue.text: Socrates moved across island in exile

indicators.note: across says the rearranged letters stretch around the island letter
moved says the letters of the name are shifted into a new order

explanation.surface: The Greek philosopher was relocated to an island in banishment.
explanation.definitionFit: To banish someone from society is to exile them, as Athens literally did by vote.

clue.text: Men submerged in river's fast-moving flow

indicators.note: submerged in puts the first piece inside the river

parts.note: the Trent is an English river
OR, other ranks, means enlisted men

explanation.surface: Soldiers caught in a river's rushing current.
explanation.definitionFit: A violent rush of water is a fast-moving flow, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Hollywood location's causing a sensation all the time

parts.note: Hollywood is in Los Angeles, LA, with its possessive S
something causing a sensation makes you tingly

explanation.surface: A film-town venue keeps giving visitors a thrill.
explanation.definitionFit: Something done enduringly continues all the time, so the adverb for permanence fits.

clue.text: Wine that's sparkling, right, not still

parts.note: Asti is a sparkling Italian wine

explanation.surface: A sparkling wine is rightly described as not still.
explanation.definitionFit: Being up and moving about is the opposite of keeping still.

clue.text: Example of body art -——- beat that!

definitions.meaning: an inked design on the skin
a rhythmic drumming, as in a military drum signal

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both an inked skin design and a drum signal or rhythmic tapping.

clue.text: Give inaccurate info about gallery's beauty queen?

parts.note: beauty contest winners are titled Miss, as in Miss World
the Tate is a London art gallery

explanation.surface: Someone spreads false information about a gallery's beauty-contest winner.
explanation.definitionFit: To report something wrongly is to give inaccurate information about it, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Skinny contender, malnourished to some extent

indicators.note: to some extent says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A thin, underfed competitor is described as partly starved.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Skinny' looks like an adjective for thin, but here it means relating to the skin.
explanation.definitionFit: Skinny here is read playfully as relating to the skin, the medical adjective for it.

clue.text: Wet and stormy in western and eastern parts

indicators.note: stormy suggests the letters are tossed into disorder

explanation.surface: Damp, blustery weather across the west and east of the country.
explanation.definitionFit: Lashed by rain is a particular way of being wet.

clue.text: Small person could be bitter

definitions.meaning: an informal term for a short or slight person
bitter is a British beer, often ordered by this measure

explanation.definitionFit: The term is slang for a tiny person and also a measure of beer such as bitter, a British ale.

clue.text: Take emergency action since country has deposed leader

parts.note: for can mean since or because

indicators.note: the leading letter of the country is removed

parts.note: Iceland is a country

explanation.surface: A nation in crisis acts urgently after removing its head of state.
explanation.definitionFit: Bringing an aircraft down in an emergency is the drastic action the verb describes.

clue.text: Writer upset one drink at pub, then second

indicators.note: in a down clue, upset turns the pieces upwards, reading them backwards

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one
ale is a drink
a bar is a pub

explanation.surface: An author knocks over a single drink at the pub, then another.
explanation.definitionFit: Rabelais was a French Renaissance author of Gargantua and Pantagruel.

clue.text: Support old woman during visit

parts.note: one's old woman can be one's mother, MA
during means in
a visit is a stay

explanation.surface: An elderly lady offers help while she is staying with someone.
explanation.definitionFit: A chief support or prop is the core meaning, from the stay holding up a ship's mast.

clue.text: Black dress not acceptable early in the day

indicators.note: not says the following letter is left out

parts.note: black clothes worn after a death are mourning
U means upper-class, hence socially acceptable

explanation.surface: A black outfit is unsuitable for the early hours.
explanation.definitionFit: The early part of the day is the time from dawn to noon.

clue.text: Garments made from various fibres

indicators.note: various suggests the letters of the word are put into different arrangements

explanation.surface: Clothing woven out of several kinds of thread.
explanation.definitionFit: Underpants are garments, so these short undergarments fit the definition as an example.

clue.text: Old sultan as a boy gripped by evil

indicators.note: gripped by puts the boy inside the evil

parts.note: sin is evil
a lad is a boy

explanation.surface: A youngster in the grip of wickedness as a former Muslim ruler.
explanation.definitionFit: Saladin was a twelfth-century sultan of Egypt and Syria who fought the Crusaders.

clue.text: One makes decision about you

parts.note: re means about or concerning
the person addressed, doing this crossword, is a solver

explanation.surface: Someone reaches a verdict concerning you.
explanation.walkthrough: 'You' is the crossword-setter's address to the person working the puzzle.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who settles a matter or decides firmly is one who makes a decision.

clue.text: Learner can comprehend article in foreign language

indicators.note: comprehend means include, so the article goes inside

parts.note: L is the learner-driver plate letter
a tin is a can
a is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: A student is able to understand grammar terms in another tongue.
explanation.definitionFit: The ancient Roman tongue is a foreign language to modern English speakers.

clue.text: Risk harsh punishment, contributing only one pound in chapel

parts.note: to risk money is to bet

indicators.note: the double pound sign, two Ls, is cut to a single L, so one letter goes

parts.note: hell is harsh punishment

explanation.surface: A churchgoer gambles on severe penalties while putting only a pound in the collection.
explanation.definitionFit: A Nonconformist place of worship is often named this, from the Hebrew for house of God.

clue.text: First indication of hospitality, having everyone round?

definitions.text: First indication of hospitality, having everyone round?

indicators.note: first indication of takes the opening letter of the next word

parts.note: all means everyone
O is round in shape

explanation.surface: A host's welcome, with everybody invited over.
explanation.definitionFit: A greeting is the first sign of hospitality when welcoming everyone to your home.

clue.text: Force-fed, oddly, unlike battery hens

indicators.note: oddly takes the odd-numbered letters of the word

explanation.surface: Fattened birds are force-fed, unlike caged hens.
explanation.definitionFit: Battery hens are caged, so birds unlike them roam unconfined, as with free-range.

clue.text: Showing a lack of competence in record time

parts.note: an EP is an extended-play record

explanation.surface: Someone shows incompetence while making a record in good time.
explanation.definitionFit: Clumsy or unskilled is a direct synonym for showing a lack of competence.

clue.text: Sent by plane, I landed first of all in Madeira resort

indicators.note: to re-sort is to arrange again, so the letters are rearranged
first of all takes only the opening letter of the following word

explanation.surface: A traveller reports flying in to a Portuguese island holiday spot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'resort' looks like a holiday place but signals re-sort: rearrange I, L and MADEIRA.
explanation.definitionFit: Post dispatched by air is sent by plane, the verb's past participle matching.

clue.text: Shut eyes and concentrate

definitions.meaning: an idiom for going to sleep or taking a nap
the same idiom also means applying oneself to work

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means both to sleep and to focus hard on a task.
